summary.en: Tasks, not magic · Learning from examples · Different skills
summary.zhHans: 任务，不是魔法 · 从例子学习 · 能力各不相同

keyIdea.en: AI methods help computers recognize, predict, generate, or choose actions. A useful task has an input and a result people can check.
keyIdea.zhHans: AI 方法帮助计算机识别、预测、生成内容或选择行动。一个有用的任务要有输入，也要有能检查的结果。

body.en: AI methods help computers recognize, predict, generate, or choose actions. A useful task has an input and a result people can check.
body.zhHans: AI 方法帮助计算机识别、预测、生成内容或选择行动。一个有用的任务要有输入，也要有能检查的结果。

example.en: Mia points a camera at a daisy. The app suggests 'daisy'; Mia checks its petals instead of assuming the phone knows everything.
example.zhHans: 小米把镜头对准雏菊，应用提示“雏菊”。她检查花瓣，而不是认定手机什么都知道。

body.en: Some AI systems fit patterns from examples. The examples influence what the system can recognize; seeing one category well does not teach every category.
body.zhHans: 有些 AI 系统从样本中学习模式。样本决定系统见过什么；学会一种类别，并不意味着学会所有类别。

example.en: A fruit app trained on apples and bananas meets a dragon fruit for the first time. It may need to say 'unknown'.
example.zhHans: 只学过苹果和香蕉的水果应用第一次遇到火龙果，合理的回答可能是“不知道”。

body.en: Success at one task does not prove success at another. Recognizing an object, understanding a question, and moving a robot require different capabilities.
body.zhHans: 完成一个任务不代表能完成另一个任务。识别物体、理解问题和控制机器人需要不同能力。

example.en: A chess program wins a game but cannot automatically help a robot tie a shoelace.
example.zhHans: 棋类程序赢了比赛，却不会因此自动学会帮机器人系鞋带。

summary.en: Explicit rules · Learned patterns · Combining methods
summary.zhHans: 明确的规则 · 学习出的模式 · 组合方法

keyIdea.en: A rule states what to do when a condition holds. People write the condition and action before the system uses them.
keyIdea.zhHans: 规则规定条件成立时该做什么。人在系统使用规则前写好条件和行动。

body.en: A rule states what to do when a condition holds. People write the condition and action before the system uses them.
body.zhHans: 规则规定条件成立时该做什么。人在系统使用规则前写好条件和行动。

example.en: The school gate says: if a valid card is scanned, unlock. A rejected card keeps the gate closed.
example.zhHans: 校门规则是：刷到有效卡就开门；无效卡则不开门。

body.en: A learned model estimates patterns from data rather than receiving every decision rule by hand. It can still make mistakes.
body.zhHans: 学习模型从数据估计模式，不需要人手工写出每一条判断规则，但仍可能出错。

example.en: Instead of listing every spelling of spam, an email filter learns from messages people marked as spam or normal.
example.zhHans: 邮件过滤器不逐一列出垃圾邮件的所有写法，而是从被标记的邮件学习。

body.en: One application can use both rules and learned models. Rules can enforce limits while a model handles variable inputs.
body.zhHans: 应用可以同时使用规则和学习模型。规则可以限制行为，模型处理变化的输入。

example.en: A photo app predicts a face, but a written rule prevents sharing the photo until a parent confirms.
example.zhHans: 照片应用预测人脸位置，但明确规则要求家长确认后才能分享。

summary.en: Sensors supply observations · Processing connects input and result · Actions affect the environment
summary.zhHans: 传感器提供观测 · 处理连接输入和结果 · 行动影响环境

keyIdea.en: A sensor measures part of the environment. Cameras capture light, microphones capture sound, and temperature sensors measure temperature.
keyIdea.zhHans: 传感器测量环境的一部分。相机记录光，麦克风记录声音，温度传感器测量温度。

body.en: A sensor measures part of the environment. Cameras capture light, microphones capture sound, and temperature sensors measure temperature.
body.zhHans: 传感器测量环境的一部分。相机记录光，麦克风记录声音，温度传感器测量温度。

example.en: A tiny greenhouse measures 32°C. The thermometer does not know who watered the plants; it only measures temperature.
example.zhHans: 小温室测到 32°C。温度计不知道是谁浇了水，它只测量温度。

body.en: Software transforms measurements into a decision or description. A measurement and a prediction are different steps.
body.zhHans: 软件把测量值转换为决定或描述。测量和预测是不同步骤。

keyIdea.en: A feature is a recorded property used as input. Good features are available when the system needs to make a prediction.
keyIdea.zhHans: 特征是用作输入的属性。有用的特征应在系统进行预测时已经可以获得。

body.en: A feature is a recorded property used as input. Good features are available when the system needs to make a prediction.
body.zhHans: 特征是用作输入的属性。有用的特征应在系统进行预测时已经可以获得。

example.en: A fruit sorter reads weight and color before deciding apple or orange.
example.zhHans: 水果分拣器先读取重量和颜色，再判断苹果或橙子。

body.en: In supervised learning, a label is the target attached to an example. Labels can be wrong, so their source matters.
body.zhHans: 监督学习中的标签是样本对应的目标答案。标签可能标错，因此来源很重要。

example.en: An adult writes 'orange' on a fruit photo. If the photo is actually a peach, the sorter receives a misleading lesson.
example.zhHans: 成人给水果照片标“橙子”。如果照片实际是桃子，分拣器就学到了错误信息。

body.en: Inputs describe what is known; the target describes what to predict. Keeping them separate prevents accidentally giving away the answer.
body.zhHans: 输入描述已知信息，目标描述需要预测的内容。区分二者可避免不小心泄露答案。

example.en: To predict tomorrow's height, the gardener can use today's height. Tomorrow's measured height belongs to the answer, not today's input.
example.zhHans: 预测明天株高时可用今天株高。明天实际测得的高度是答案，不是今天的输入。

keyIdea.en: Classification chooses from defined categories. Clear category meanings help people and models use the same labels.
keyIdea.zhHans: 分类从预先定义的类别中做选择。明确类别含义有助于人与模型使用相同标签。

body.en: Classification chooses from defined categories. Clear category meanings help people and models use the same labels.
body.zhHans: 分类从预先定义的类别中做选择。明确类别含义有助于人与模型使用相同标签。

example.en: A recycling app uses paper, metal, and glass. It must define where a mixed carton belongs.
example.zhHans: 回收应用分纸、金属和玻璃。它还必须明确混合材质纸盒应该如何处理。

body.en: A decision boundary separates categories using features. Similar-looking objects near the boundary may be difficult to classify.
body.zhHans: 决策边界利用特征区分类别。边界附近看起来相似的物体可能难以分类。

example.en: A toy sorter calls objects longer than 10 cm 'long'. A 10.1 cm object is near its cutoff.
example.zhHans: 玩具分拣器把超过 10 厘米的物体叫“长”。10.1 厘米的物体就在分界附近。

body.en: A system should not force every unfamiliar item into a familiar category. An unknown option or human check can be safer.
body.zhHans: 系统不必把所有陌生物体硬塞进熟悉类别。增加未知选项或人工检查可能更安全。

example.en: The recycling camera sees a battery. Since batteries are not in its three classes, it asks an adult for help.

summary.en: Numbers versus categories · Simple numerical rules · Residual errors
summary.zhHans: 数值与类别 · 简单数值规则 · 残差误差

keyIdea.en: Regression predicts a numerical quantity. A temperature estimate and a choice between hot/cold answer different kinds of questions.
keyIdea.zhHans: 回归预测数值。估计温度与选择热或冷，回答的是不同类型的问题。

body.en: Regression predicts a numerical quantity. A temperature estimate and a choice between hot/cold answer different kinds of questions.
body.zhHans: 回归预测数值。估计温度与选择热或冷，回答的是不同类型的问题。

example.en: A garden model predicts 18 cm of height; a separate classifier predicts 'healthy'.
example.zhHans: 花园模型预测株高 18 厘米；另一个分类器预测“健康”。

body.en: A numerical model can combine an input with a rate and starting value. The rule is an approximation of the situation.
body.zhHans: 数值模型可把输入与变化率、起点值组合。这条规则是对现实情况的近似。

example.en: A fictional seedling starts at 5 cm and grows an estimated 2 cm per day: after three days, the model predicts 11 cm.
example.zhHans: 一株虚构幼苗起初高 5 厘米，估计每天长 2 厘米；三天后模型预测 11 厘米。

body.en: The difference between an observed number and a predicted number is a residual. Comparing residuals helps judge a numerical model.
body.zhHans: 实际数值与预测数值之差称为残差。比较残差有助于判断数值模型。

example.en: The model predicts 11 cm, but the seedling measures 9 cm. Its observation-minus-prediction residual is −2 cm.
example.zhHans: 模型预测 11 厘米，实际测得 9 厘米。实际减预测的残差为 −2 厘米。

summary.en: Feedback compares · Correction is not instant learning · Measure several cases
summary.zhHans: 反馈需要比较 · 纠正不等于立刻学习 · 测量多个样本

keyIdea.en: Feedback tells a system or learner how a result relates to a target. An error report is useful only when the intended target is clear.
keyIdea.zhHans: 反馈说明结果与目标的关系。只有目标明确时，错误报告才有用。

body.en: Feedback tells a system or learner how a result relates to a target. An error report is useful only when the intended target is clear.
body.zhHans: 反馈说明结果与目标的关系。只有目标明确时，错误报告才有用。

example.en: A spelling app suggests 'cat' for a picture of a cap. The teacher supplies 'cap' as the correct target.
example.zhHans: 拼写应用把帽子照片判断为 cat。老师把 cap 作为正确目标。

body.en: Showing the correct answer does not necessarily retrain the app. Some systems update only when their developers run a new training process.
body.zhHans: 显示正确答案不一定会重新训练应用。有些系统只有在开发者运行新训练过程后才更新。

example.en: Nora corrects one flower label. The app records the correction, but the model may stay unchanged until its next update.
example.zhHans: 诺诺纠正一个花名。应用记录了纠正，但模型可能要等下一次更新才改变。

body.en: One success or failure is not a full evaluation. A collection of relevant cases helps reveal patterns in mistakes.
body.zhHans: 一次成功或失败不足以完成评估。一组相关样本有助于发现错误规律。

example.en: A reading app works on one clear recording but fails on several noisy recordings. Testing both reveals a useful limitation.
example.zhHans: 阅读应用处理一条清晰录音成功，却在多条嘈杂录音上失败。测试两种情况才能发现局限。

example.en: A floor robot senses a chair and turns; a calendar helper sends a reminder without wheels.
example.zhHans: 扫地机器人感知椅子后转向，日历助手没有轮子也能发送提醒。

body.en: A goal states what an agent should achieve. Competing goals may require choices, such as cleaning well while avoiding damage.
body.zhHans: 目标说明智能体应实现什么，目标冲突时需要取舍，例如扫干净同时避免损坏物品。

example.en: A robot should clean crumbs without bumping a vase. Fastest movement is not its only goal.
example.zhHans: 机器人要清扫碎屑又不撞倒花瓶，移动最快不是唯一目标。

body.en: Actions can change the world, so an agent should use later observations. A remembered map may become outdated.
body.zhHans: 行动能改变世界，所以智能体要使用后续观测，记住的地图可能过时。

example.en: A chair is moved after the robot's first scan. A new scan helps avoid its new position.
example.zhHans: 机器人第一次扫描后椅子被挪动，新扫描有助于避开椅子的新位置。

example.en: A homework photo accidentally shows a child's full name and home address at the top of the page.
example.zhHans: 作业照片顶部不小心拍到孩子全名和家庭地址。

body.en: A task may work with less personal data. Removing unnecessary identifying details reduces exposure, though it may not remove every risk.
body.zhHans: 任务可能不需要那么多个人数据，删除不必要身份细节可减少暴露，但未必消除所有风险。

example.en: To ask about a math question, the child crops the question and leaves out the address.
example.zhHans: 孩子问数学题时，只裁出题目，把地址去掉。

body.en: People should understand what is shared and with whom. Children can ask a trusted adult before sharing unfamiliar or sensitive information.
body.zhHans: 人应知道分享什么、分享给谁，儿童可在分享陌生或敏感信息前求助可信成人。

example.en: An app asks to upload classroom faces. A teacher checks permission rather than accepting without discussion.
example.zhHans: 应用要求上传全班人脸，老师先检查是否获得许可，而不是未经讨论就同意。

body.en: An algorithm is a precise sequence of steps. A search problem describes a starting state, allowed actions, and a goal.

example.en: A maze state is your current square; an action moves to an adjacent open square.

body.en: Breadth-first search explores all states one step away before states two steps away. With equal action costs, it finds a shortest path, but may store many states.

example.en: A friend is one connection away; a friend's friend is two. Explore each layer to find the fewest connections.

body.en: A heuristic is a helpful estimate used to choose which route to try first. Route planners use it to avoid checking every possibility; an estimate can still overlook obstacles.
body.zhHans: 启发式是帮助决定先尝试哪条路线的估计。路线规划用它减少不必要搜索，但估计仍可能忽略障碍。

example.en: On a four-direction grid without shortcuts, horizontal distance plus vertical distance gives a useful lower bound.
example.zhHans: 在只能上下左右移动、没有捷径的网格上，横纵距离之和是有用的下界。

keyIdea.en: A proposition is a statement with a truth value. AND requires both statements to be true; OR requires at least one; NOT reverses a truth value.
keyIdea.zhHans: 命题是具有真值的陈述。且要求两项都真，或要求至少一项真，非会反转真值。

body.en: A proposition is a statement with a truth value. AND requires both statements to be true; OR requires at least one; NOT reverses a truth value.
body.zhHans: 命题是具有真值的陈述。且要求两项都真，或要求至少一项真，非会反转真值。

example.en: A club opens when it is Saturday AND a teacher is present. Saturday alone does not open it.

body.en: The rule 'if A, then B' says B must hold when A holds. It does not generally imply 'if B, then A'; other causes may produce B.
body.zhHans: 如果A则B，意味着A成立时B必须成立。通常不能反推如果B则A，因为B可能有其他原因。

example.en: If it rains, a path may become wet. A wet path could also result from a sprinkler.
example.zhHans: 下雨可使道路变湿，但洒水器也会使道路变湿。

body.en: A constraint limits combinations of variable values. A solution assigns every variable a value that satisfies all constraints; there can be zero, one, or many solutions.
body.zhHans: 约束限制变量值的组合。解为所有变量赋值并满足所有约束；解可能为零个、一个或多个。

keyIdea.en: A true positive is correctly predicted positive. A false positive is a negative case predicted positive; a false negative is a positive case missed.

keyIdea.en: k-nearest neighbors predicts using the k closest stored examples. Classification can use a majority vote; regression can average their numeric targets.

body.en: k-nearest neighbors predicts using the k closest stored examples. Classification can use a majority vote; regression can average their numeric targets.

example.en: Three nearby labeled fruits are apple, apple, pear. A 3-neighbor vote predicts apple.
example.zhHans: 附近三个已标水果为苹果、苹果、梨，3近邻投票预测苹果。

body.en: Small k can follow noise closely. Larger k smooths predictions but may blur local distinctions. Choose k using validation data rather than final test results.
body.zhHans: 较小k可能紧随噪声，较大k会平滑预测但可能模糊局部差异。应以验证数据选择k，不能反复利用最终测试结果。

example.en: One mislabeled neighbor can flip a 1-neighbor decision; a vote among five may resist that single error.

body.en: The learning rate sets update size. Too large can overshoot; too small can be slow. Check training curves and validation performance rather than trusting one setting.
body.zhHans: 学习率设置更新幅度，过大可能越过目标，过小可能很慢。应检查训练曲线与验证表现。

example.en: A game character's position is a state, moving left is an action, and reaching a target earns reward.

body.en: The best action may have little immediate reward but better future outcomes. A return combines rewards over time; discounting gives less weight to distant rewards.

example.en: Taking a detour gives no immediate point but reaches a larger treasure later.
example.zhHans: 绕路即时没分，但之后到更大宝藏。

body.en: Exploration tries less-known actions; exploitation uses currently promising actions. Reward design matters because an agent may optimize the measured reward in unintended ways.
body.zhHans: 探索尝试较未知行动，利用采取当前看好的行动。奖励设计重要，因为智能体可能用非预期方式优化分数。

example.en: A cleaning robot rewarded only for time moving may circle instead of cleaning. Reward actual cleaning and check safety.
example.zhHans: 仅奖励移动时间的扫地机器人可能绕圈，需衡量真实清洁并检查安全。

example.en: For next-day bike demand, predict rides per station per day using only information available the evening before.

body.en: A baseline is a reference strategy such as majority-class prediction or yesterday's value. Compare models using the same splits and metrics; complexity is useful only when evidence supports improvement.

example.zhHans: 同一测试上模型MAE12，比上周同日基线MAE9更差。

body.en: Metrics should connect to error costs and operational constraints. Latency, memory, privacy, and human review requirements can change the best practical choice.

body.en: Softmax converts several category scores into probabilities that add to one. A model can choose the largest, but this does not ensure the true category was included among its options.

keyIdea.en: A diffusion model defines a sequence that progressively adds noise to data. Known noise schedules create training pairs; the noising process itself is not image generation.
keyIdea.zhHans: 扩散模型定义逐步给数据加噪的序列。已知噪声日程产生训练对，加噪过程本身不是图像生成。

body.en: A diffusion model defines a sequence that progressively adds noise to data. Known noise schedules create training pairs; the noising process itself is not image generation.
body.zhHans: 扩散模型定义逐步给数据加噪的序列。已知噪声日程产生训练对，加噪过程本身不是图像生成。

example.en: A clean synthetic shape becomes increasingly noisy over successive training steps.
example.zhHans: 干净合成形状随训练步骤逐渐变噪。

body.en: In a common DDPM formulation, a network predicts added noise from a noisy sample and a time step. A training loss compares predicted noise with the known sampled noise.
body.zhHans: 常见DDPM形式中，网络根据带噪样本与时间步预测所加噪声，训练损失比较预测噪声与已知采样噪声。

example.en: If sampled noise is 0.4 and predicted noise is 0.1 for one coordinate, squared error is 0.09.
example.zhHans: 某坐标采样噪声0.4、预测0.1，平方误差0.09。

body.en: Generation starts from noise and applies learned reverse steps. Conditioning can guide samples toward text or other inputs; steps, guidance, and model quality trade speed against output properties.

keyIdea.en: An MDP specifies states, actions, transition probabilities, rewards, and a discount. The Markov assumption says the current state contains information needed to predict the next transition given an action.
keyIdea.zhHans: MDP规定状态、行动、转移概率、奖励与折扣。马尔可夫假设指给定行动后当前状态含预测下一转移所需信息。

body.en: An MDP specifies states, actions, transition probabilities, rewards, and a discount. The Markov assumption says the current state contains information needed to predict the next transition given an action.
body.zhHans: MDP规定状态、行动、转移概率、奖励与折扣。马尔可夫假设指给定行动后当前状态含预测下一转移所需信息。

example.en: A grid robot's state may need both position and battery; position alone may omit information affecting the next move.
example.zhHans: 网格机器人状态可能需位置与电量，只用位置可能漏掉影响下一步的信息。

body.en: A Q value estimates the future reward of taking an action in a state. Q-learning builds a target from the immediate reward and a discounted estimate of what comes next; a terminal step has no future reward.
body.zhHans: Q 值估计在某状态行动的未来奖励。Q 学习用即时奖励和折扣后的后续估计构建目标；终止步骤没有未来奖励。

example.en: Reward 2, discount 0.9, and next best Q=10 yield a target of 11.
example.zhHans: 奖励2、折扣0.9、下一最大Q10，目标11。

body.en: A Q-learning update moves an old estimate partway toward its new target. The update size controls how much it changes. Learning guarantees require assumptions, and real actions also need safety controls.
body.zhHans: Q 学习把旧估计朝新目标移动一部分，更新幅度控制变化量。学习保证需要假设，真实行动还需要安全控制。

example.en: Q=5, target 11, and α=0.5 update Q to 8; a physical robot cannot freely test dangerous moves.
example.zhHans: Q5、目标11、α0.5更新为8，实体机器人不能自由试危险行动。

keyIdea.en: A model card records intended uses, evaluation conditions, limitations, and ethical considerations. A datasheet documents dataset collection and composition; neither is a certification of safety.
keyIdea.zhHans: 模型卡记录目标用途、评估条件、局限及伦理考虑，数据说明记录收集与构成。两者都不是安全认证。

example.en: A speech model card lists tested accents, noisy-room error rates, and uses that were not evaluated.
example.zhHans: 语音模型卡列已测试口音、噪声房间错误率与未评估用途。

body.en: Deployment data may differ from training data. Monitor input distributions and task-relevant outcomes with privacy-aware collection; a drift signal alone does not prove accuracy declined.
body.zhHans: 部署数据可能不同于训练数据。用兼顾隐私的收集监测输入分布与任务结果，漂移信号本身不证明准确率下降。

example.en: A demand model sees holiday traffic patterns absent from training; compare outcome errors before deciding to retrain.
example.zhHans: 需求模型遇到训练未有的节假日流量，应比较结果误差再决定重训。

body.en: Define escalation, versioning, and rollback before release. High-stakes uses need domain-appropriate human oversight; a learning app's examples do not qualify a model for medical or legal decisions.
body.zhHans: 发布前定义升级处理、版本管理与回滚。高风险用途需领域适当人工监督，学习应用例子不证明模型能做医疗法律决策。

example.en: If a new model doubles complaint errors, a team can restore the previous version while investigating.
example.zhHans: 新模型让投诉错误翻倍时，团队可调查期间恢复旧版本。
